Current recommended practice in RFC3704 is to enable strict mode to prevent IP spoofing from DDos attacks. If using asymmetric routing or other complicated routing, then loose mode is recommended. The max value from conf/{all,interface}/rp_filter is used when doing source validation on the {interface}. Default value is 0. NOTES top Starting with Linux kernel version 3.6, there is no routing cache for IPv4 anymore. Hence ip route show cached will never print any entries on systems with this or newer kernel versions. action_semantics.address_add: Restore the exact intended IPv4 address on the interface with address_missing.
action_semantics.firewall_clear: Remove injected filter rules for a measured firewall_drop; local intended filter is empty.
action_semantics.link_down/route_delete/address_delete: Introduce or preserve faults; not restorative repair actions.
action_semantics.link_up: Set an administratively down interface UP; restores a link_down fault on that interface.
action_semantics.route_replace: Restore the intended gateway for route_missing/route_wrong, or a measured absent route whose gateway lies in an interface subnet restored by address_add or link_up in the same plan.
